text: つかいみち　ないから　きんのたまを　うったら　５０００円で　うれた！

structure.jp: つかいみち　ないから
structure.en: because I had no use for it

structure.jp: きんのたまを　うったら

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら here means 'when I did this', followed by what turned out, often a surprise. うったら = 'when I sold it'.

patterns.name: 〜から
patterns.explanation: から after a statement means 'because', giving the reason for what follows. つかいみち　ないから = 'because I had no use for it'.
